continuity: Taekyung’s force has gathered thirty thousand people for the advance up the Great Snow Mountain; more than half are from unorthodox factions, and Taekyung is concerned that the force’s numbers overstate its strength.
Hong Pyo, a Deputy Thousand Captain of the Gansu Regional Military Commission, strictly enforces identity checks at a military checkpoint and recognizes Taekyung as the Marquis of Shangshan.
Urgent war drums sound from beyond the ridge; their source and what prompted them are unknown.
plot: As Taekyung’s thirty-thousand-strong force struggles up the Great Snow Mountain, he worries that its numbers conceal a lack of strength and that Sima Gong may have his own designs. A Gansu military officer, Hong Pyo, recognizes Taekyung as the Marquis of Shangshan and salutes him, then insists on checking Sima Gong’s identity tablet despite his status. Jeok Cheongang approves of Hong Pyo’s strict devotion to duty.

Before the group can respond to the urgent war drums echoing from beyond the ridge, Hyuk Mujin jokes about losing control from excitement at the troops’ salute, and Taekyung tells him to keep his dignity as a marquis.
translation_decisions: Render 홍표 as Hong Pyo, 위지휘사사 as Regional Military Commission, and 부천호 as Deputy Thousand Captain.

active_continuity: Taekyung’s thirty-thousand-strong force is advancing up the Great Snow Mountain; more than half are from unorthodox factions, and Taekyung doubts its strength.
Allied signals have confirmed that the Great Snow Mountain is occupied by Taekyung’s side.
Dark Heaven captured Dunhuang after breaching the Jade Gate Pass, inflicting catastrophic losses on the defenders.
A middle-aged Dark Heaven killer slaughtered more than a hundred Kongtong Sect members, including the Kongtong Sword Dragon; his identity and strength are unknown.
Taekyung suspects Dark Heaven has at least three Supreme Peak masters or one overwhelmingly powerful superhuman; he wonders whether the Lord of Heaven is involved.
Sima Gong ordered Sama Pyo to watch Taekyung’s group; the secret letter Sama Pyo received remains unexplained.
The Kongtong Sect Leader escaped Dunhuang, but his whereabouts remain unknown.
Hong Pyo is a Deputy Thousand Captain of the Gansu Regional Military Commission who strictly enforces identity checks at a checkpoint on the mountain.
Urgent war drums sound from beyond the ridge; their source is unknown.
open_questions: Who sent Sama Pyo the secret letter, what did it say, and are Sima Gong’s orders involving Pyo and Taishan connected to Dark Heaven?
Where is the Kongtong Sect Leader?
Who is the middle-aged killer, and what is the extent of his strength?
What hidden strength gave Dark Heaven confidence to invade Gansu, and is the Lord of Heaven involved?
What is happening beyond the ridge, and what prompted the war drums?

names.notes: Deputy Thousand Captain of the Gansu Regional Military Commission.

profile_creations.personality: Steadfast and inflexible, he prioritizes the duties and procedures of his post over the status of those he questions.
profile_creations.relationships: Hong Pyo serves under the Regional Military Commissioner and recognizes Jin Taekyung as the Marquis of Shangshan.
profile_creations.role: Hong Pyo is a Deputy Thousand Captain of the Gansu Regional Military Commission who commands troops at a checkpoint on the Great Snow Mountain.
profile_creations.voice: Direct and formal in carrying out official duties, with blunt, disrespectful address when challenging those who resist his procedures.
